running_text:
τάχορδον, τὰς τοῦ † πέντε δυνάμεις περιλαμβάνον· τὸ δὲ ὀκτάχορδον, τὴν * ὕλην τοῦ διὰ πασῶν περιέχον ἰσχὺν. τὸ δὲ κατὰ συνέχειαν, ἑκκαιδεκάχορδον, τὴν τοῦ δὶς διὰ πασῶν ὁλοσχερῆ συνέχον διάτασιν, διπλᾶς τὰς δυνάμεις ἀποφερόμενον· αὐτάς τε γὰρ τὰς προειρημένας, καὶ τὰς τοῦ δὶς διὰ τεσσάρων, καὶ τοῦ δὶς διὰ πέντε, καὶ τοῦ δὶς διὰ πασῶν ἐν ἑαυτῷ περιέχει. Διαφέρει δὲ τὰ συστήματα τῶν ἐν μέσῳ διαστημάτων, τῷ τὰ μὲν ἐν ὕλῃ τὴν σύστασιν ἔχειν, τὰ δὲ διαστήματα ἐξ ἀφαιρέσεως τῆς ὕλης νοεῖσθαι. Τῆς δὲ ἁρμονίας ἴδιον, τὸ τὰ τοιαῦτα συστήματα συντάττειν καὶ συναρμολογεῖν πρὸς τὸ τοῖόνδε τῆς μελῳδίας γένος· οἷον τὸ διάτονον, τὸ χρωματικὸν, καὶ τὸ παρωνύμως ἀπ’ αὐτῆς ἁρμονίας, ἁρμονικὸν προσαγορευόμενον. Εἰ μὲν οὖν διὰ τόνων τὸ πλεῖστον ἡ ἁρμονία προάγοιτο, τὸ διάτονον οὕτω καλούμενον κατασκευάζεται γένος· εἰ δὲ δι’ ἡμιτονίων, τὸ χρωματικόν· εἰ δὲ διέσεσι μαλλον * ἢ ἁρμονία συνέχεται, τὸ ἁρμόνικον λεγόμενον ἀπαρτίζεται μέλος. οὐ μὴν τὸ πᾶν διὰ τόνων τὰ τῆς ἁρμονίας προφέρεται, οὐδὲ δι’ ἡμιτονίων τὸ πᾶν, οὐδὲ τὸ πᾶν ἐκ διέσεων, οὐδὲ γὰρ δυνατὸν. Αλλ’ ἐπεὶ τρισὶ διαστάσεσι τὸ διὰ τεσσάρων ἀπήρτισται, δυσὶ δὲ τόνοις καὶ ἡμιτονίῳ διείληπται, δύο τονιαίων διαστημάτων ἐκτιθεμένων, ἀνάγκη τὸ λοιπὸν τελεῖν ἡμιτόνιον. καὶ τοῦτ’ ἂν εἴη τὸ διὰ τεσσάρων διάτονον ὀνομαζόμενον γένος, ἐξ ἡμιτονίου καὶ δύο ἀπαρτιζόμενον τόνων. εἰ δὲ δύο εἴη τὰ ἡμιτόνια, τὸ λοιπὸν γένοιτ’ ἂν ἓν ἐκ συμφθάρσεως διάστημα, τριημιτόνιον ἀσύνθετον ἐξ ἡμιτονίων δύο καὶ τριημιτονίου συγκεκραμένον. εἴη δ’ ἂν τοῦτο τὸ διὰ τεσσάρων γένος χρωματικὸν, παθητικώτερόν τε τοῦ προτέρου, καὶ γοέτερον. εἰ δὲ κατὰ δύο διέσεις ἡ μελῳδία προάγοιτο, θάτερον ἔσται τῶν διαστημάτων ἓν διτόνιον ἐκ συμφθάρσεως· καὶ τὸ διατεσσάρων τοῦτο γένος, ἁρμονικὸν ὀνομάζεται, τῷ εἶναι ἄριστον ἐκ τῆς κοινῆς ἁρμονίας τὴν παρωνυμίαν ἀπενεγκάμενον. τὸν ὅμοιον δὲ τρόπον καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ τῶν συστημάτων ἡ ἁρμονία συντάττει. τῷ γὰρ ἑνὸς * τὸ τετραχόρδου περὶ τὰ διαστήματα τοῦ διὰ τεσσάρων συντακτικῷ ὑποδείγματι, ῥᾴδιον τῷ φιλομαθεῖ καὶ περὶ τῶν ἑξῆς συστημάτων καταστοχάζεσθαι. δυσμελῳδικώτατον μέντοι τὸ ἁρμονικὸν γένος τῆς μελῳδίας ἐστὶ, καὶ πολλῆς τριβῆς καὶ συνηθείας δεόμενον, ὅθεν οὐδ’ εἰς χρῆσιν ῥᾳδίως ἔρχεται. τὸ δὲ διάτονον, ἁπλοῦν τε καὶ γενναῖον, καὶ φυσικώτερον· διὸ δὴ τοῦτο παραλαμβάνει καὶ Πλάτων. τούτων δὲ πάλιν ἕκαστον ποικίλλεται, καὶ εἰς πολλὰς διαιρέσεις, καὶ διαφορὰς, καὶ εἴδη μελῳδιῶν κατατέμνεται· καὶ νῦν μὲν λύδιον, νῦν δὲ φρύγιον, νῦν δὲ δώριον ἐναρμόζεται μέλος, ὧν ἐφ’ ἑκάστῳ παιήων, ὑμεραῖος, ἐξόδιος, καὶ ὅσα εἴδη μελῳδιῶν, ἀναφαίνεται. οὐ γὰρ τῇ τῶν διαστημάτων μόνῃ διαφορᾷ, ἀλλὰ καὶ ταῖς σχολαιοτέραις καὶ ταχιναῖς μεταβάσεσι, διαμοναῖς τε καὶ ῥοαῖς, καὶ ταῖς τῶν ἐπαφῶν καὶ κρουμάτων ποικίλαις μεταχειρίσεσι, τὰ μύρια τῶν μελῳδιῶν, καὶ ποίκιλα κατασκευάζεται.

Τέλος τῆς Μουσικῆς:

notes.comment: Running head centred, page number 31 at the outer (right) corner. The page continues the text of p. 30 (first word τάχορδον completes τετρά- of p. 30). 25 text lines; catchword at the foot (see note p. 31 line 25). No paragraph indents on this page.

Ligatures/compendia silently expanded: καί sign, ου (ȣ), στ (ς), ερ (ϐ-like), εν (γ-like), μεν, τῶν, τῆς, ὴν, τοῦ, τῷ, -ος, δὲ, ἐστί, συν, τι, σχ. Iota subscripts (printed as a dot under the vowel) given as ι subscript; raised point → ·. Acute and grave are both near-vertical strokes in this fount, so acute/grave distinctions in final syllables carry some uncertainty.

Obelus † in the text before πέντε, keyed to a note in the outer (right) margin printed over two lines (level with lines 1–2): «† διὰ πέν-|τε.» — i.e. read τὰς τοῦ διὰ πέντε δυνάμεις. Text transcribed as printed (τοῦ † πέντε), the † kept in the line.
πέντε is set with the εν-ligature (looks like γ́ν); same form in line 8 (διὰ πέντε).

Asterisk in the text before ὕλην keyed to a right-margin note printed level with line 3 (line 2 of the margin is taken by «τε.»): «* ὅλην» — the editor proposes τὴν ὅλην (‘the whole’) for τὴν ὕλην. Text kept as printed.

notes.comment: ά+ν is set with a sort in which ν is a straight stroke carrying the acute, so it looks like ‘αίν’; but no separate ν follows (contrast ἀναφαίνεται p. 33 l. 13, where αί is followed by a distinct ν). Read λαμβάνον; same sort p. 33 l. 7 (παραλαμβάνει). Verified side by side with ἀναφαίνεται (p. 33 l. 13): there the αι-sort has a short ι followed by a v-shaped ν; here the stroke after α is the v-shaped ν itself carrying the acute.
High point after λαμβάνον rendered as ·.
Grave (not acute) on υ before the full stop, as printed.

notes.what: abbreviation expanded in a debatable way
notes.comment: σχ ligature resembles χ and ερ ligature resembles ϐ/ό, so the word can be misread as ὁλοχορδῆ; reading ὁλοσχερῆ (‘entire’) with συνέχον διάτασιν. Verified: the first sort is the σχ-ligature (χ with a loop at the upper left), identical to σχολαιοτέραις p. 33 l. 15 and distinct from plain χ in συνέχον (same line).
τῷ printed as a single ligature (τ joined to ω, dot below = iota subscript). Same τῷ sort p. 31 l. 11 and p. 32 ll. 19, 22, 25 (there as a separate word).
Word divided (δια-|στημάτων) without a visible hyphen; '-' supplied by convention.

New sentence with capital Δ at the start of the line, but no indent and no gap before it: not marked para_start. Capitals also mark sentence starts mid-line: Τῆς δὲ (l. 13), Εἰ μὲν οὖν (l. 18), Αλλ’ (p. 32 l. 2).
Articular τῷ (‘in that’), ligature.
Line begins with the compendium sign for τῆς (same sign p. 32 l. 19 ἐκ τῆς κοινῆς, p. 33 l. 2 γένος τῆς).
Printed with circumflex on the ι of οι plus acute on the next ο (enclitic accent), i.e. τοῖόνδε; normal τοιόνδε. Verified at high magnification: both accents are clearly printed.

-ος written with the looped ος-compendium; also γένος p. 31 l. 21, p. 32 ll. 8, 18, p. 33 l. 2; μέλος p. 31 l. 24; ὑμεραῖος p. 33 l. 12. Not in p. 32 l. 13 (γένος: εν-ligature + ος in letters) nor p. 33 l. 11 (μέλος in letters).
Wide space before Εἰ μὲν οὖν (capital Ε) — possibly a sense break, but mid-line and probably justification spacing; not treated as a paragraph.
No circumflex visible over the α; transcribed unaccented as printed.
Acute before the high point (cf. χρωματικὸν, with grave before comma, l. 16). Acute and grave are nearly vertical in this fount; not fully certain.

Text has ἢ (smooth breathing + grave) preceded by an asterisk; right-margin note level with this line: «* ἡ» (small type; mark over η looks like a tall rough breathing, no accent). The margin corrects ἢ to the article: εἰ δὲ διέσεσι μᾶλλον ἡ ἁρμονία συνέχεται. Asterisk kept at the start of the line.
Acute printed on the ο after μ; normal ἁρμονικόν/-ὸν (cf. l. 18, p. 32 l. 18).
Catchword at the foot, right: «ρεται,» = first word of p. 32 (προφέ-|ρεται). Not counted as a text line. A faint ‘4’-like spot at the foot left is a stain, not a signature.

Page number 32 at the outer (left) corner; head with ὴν-ligature. Over ι of Εἰς only a dot-like mark is visible (breathing faint). Reads across the opening with p. 33: «Εἰς Μουσικὴν Σύνταγμα». No paragraph indents on this page.
Capital Α without a visible breathing; transcribed as printed.
Accent before the full stop looks like a grave; uncertain (near-vertical strokes).
δὲ printed with the compendium resembling ȷ with two dots and accent; same in l. 9 (εἰ δὲ δύο).
No hyphen printed at the line end (continues μένων); τι set as a ligature resembling π (cf. l. 25).
Acute over the α/ρ junction at line end; taken as συμφθάρ- (cf. l. 17 συμφθάρσεως); l. 11 σεως unaccented.
ἓν as a single ligature sort; likewise l. 17.
No punctuation printed between ἀσύνθετον and ἐξ.
Divided (συγκεκρα-|μένον) without visible hyphen; '-' supplied.
τοῦτο as compendium; also l. 18, p. 33 l. 6.

Printed γ-ο-έ-τ-(ερ-ligature)-ο-ν = γοέτερον; the comparative should be γοερώτερον (Xylander: ‘ad … luctum ciendum efficacius’). A thin vertical bar (spacing material) between ρου, and καὶ is ignored.
δια-ligature without any accent and set solid with τεσσάρων (elsewhere on the page διὰ τεσσάρων with grave and a space). Transcribed as printed: διατεσσάρων.
τῷ εἶναι ἄριστον (Xylander ‘eò quia sit optimum’): τῷ ligature, ending -αι written superscript over εἶν.
τῷ γὰρ ἑνὸς … ὑποδείγματι (Xylander ‘quia exemplo tetrachordi ostendimus’).
Asterisk before τὸ; outer (left) margin, level with this line: «* τοῦ» — correction to ἑνὸς τοῦ τετραχόρδου. Text kept as printed with the asterisk.
Divided (ὑποδείγμα-|τι) without visible hyphen; '-' supplied.

Catchword at foot right = first word of p. 33. Not counted as a text line.
Head with συν-ligature (looks like Σιώταγμα); page number 33 at the outer (right) corner.
The ἐστί compendium resembles ὅτι (ε with breathing + στ sign + ὶ). Expanded ἐστὶ, keeping the printed grave before the comma.

notes.what: abbreviation expanded in a debatable way
notes.comment: Same ά+ν sort as p. 31 l. 2 (‘αί’ followed directly by ει, no ν): παραλαμβάνει.
The compound is ἐναρμόζεται, not συναρμόζεται: the sort is the εν-ligature (cf. ὅθεν l. 4), not the συν-ligature (cf. συνηθεί- l. 3).

Printed ὑμεραῖος: the sort after ὑμ is the ερ-ligature (as in γοέτερον p. 32 l. 15, φυσικώτερον p. 33 l. 6), not εν. Misprint for ὑμεναῖος (usual ὑμέναιος); circumflex on αῖ as printed; -ος by compendium. παιήων in full; ὧν with rough breathing + circumflex.
Initial σχ ligature resembles χ; the ερ ligature carries the acute.
Lines 18–20 are set progressively narrower and centred (tapering end of section): l. 18 slightly indented, l. 19 «ποίκιλα κατασκευά-» and l. 20 «ζεται.» centred. Not paragraph starts.
Acute on οι (ποίκιλα) instead of ποικίλα; transcribed as printed.
Closing line in larger type after a blank space, centred. Final mark looks like a colon (two dots), kept as ':'.
At the foot below the heading: signature «γ» (left) and catchword «Σύνοψις» (right, announcing the next section). Not part of the music section; not transcribed as lines.

changes.before: φρύγιον, νῦν δὲ δώριον συναρμόζεται μέλος,
changes.after: φρύγιον, νῦν δὲ δώριον ἐναρμόζεται μέλος,
changes.reason: The first sort is the εν-ligature (γ-like loop + ν) with a smooth breathing, identical to the εν in ὅθεν (p. 33 l. 4), γεν- (p. 33 l. 5), ἓν (p. 32 ll. 10, 17); it is not the συν-ligature, which in this fount looks like σ + ω-shaped ‘υν’ (συνηθεί- p. 33 l. 3, συντάττει p. 32 l. 22, ἀσύνθετον p. 32 l. 11). Printed reading: δώριον ἐναρμόζεται μέλος.

changes.before: ὧν ἐφ’ ἑκάστῳ παιήων, ὑμεναῖος, ἐξόδιος,
changes.after: ὧν ἐφ’ ἑκάστῳ παιήων, ὑμεραῖος, ἐξόδιος,
changes.reason: After ὑμ the print has the ερ-ligature (δ-shaped loop arching over a ρ with descender), the same sort as in γοέτερον (p. 32 l. 15), παθητικώτερόν (p. 32 l. 14), φυσικώτερον (p. 33 l. 6), σχολαιοτέραις (p. 33 l. 15); there is no εν-ligature and no ν. Printed ὑμεραῖος (with -ος compendium) is a misprint for ὑμεναῖος/ὑμέναιος; transcribed as printed.

changes.before: τὸ διὰ τεσσάρων τοῦτο γένος, ἁρμονικὸν ὀνο-
changes.after: τὸ διατεσσάρων τοῦτο γένος, ἁρμονικὸν ὀνο-
changes.reason: Here the δια-ligature carries no accent at all (contrast διὰ τεσσάρων with a visible grave in p. 32 ll. 3, 7, 13, 24) and is set solid against τεσσάρων with no word space: printed as the compound τὸ διατεσσάρων.

still_uncertain: p. 33 l. 12 ὑμεραῖος: the ερ-ligature reading is clear on this scan, but a damaged or heavily inked εν-sort cannot be excluded absolutely; check another copy of Basel 1556 if one is available.
p. 32 l. 18 διατεσσάρων: the word division is judged from a very narrow gap; the absence of an accent on δια is certain.

Acute vs grave on final syllables remains slightly uncertain throughout, because both are near-vertical strokes in this fount (e.g. p. 31 l. 22 χρωματικόν·, p. 32 l. 2 δυνατὸν., p. 32 l. 3 τρισὶ); the transcriber’s readings are kept.
p. 31 l. 23 margin «* ἡ»: tiny type; the mark over η is read as a rough breathing without accent (as in the article ἡ in the text, p. 32 l. 22).
p. 33 l. 21: the final mark after Μουσικῆς is read as a colon; it could be a full stop with a stray dot.
verification.notes: All three pages re-read independently in enlarged crops and compared word by word with chunk-G3.json. Line counts confirmed (p. 31: 25 lines + catchword ρεται,; p. 32: 25 lines + catchword συστημά-; p. 33: 20 text lines + closing heading, then signature γ and catchword Σύνοψις); no line is missing, duplicated or wrongly divided; running heads, margin notes († διὰ πέν-|τε., * ὅλην, * ἡ, * τοῦ) and the positions of the asterisks and the obelus confirmed. 3 corrections, all in the expansion of ligatures or the printed form: p. 33 l. 11 συναρμόζεται → ἐναρμόζεται (εν-ligature, not συν); p. 33 l. 12 ὑμεναῖος → ὑμεραῖος (printed misprint, ερ-ligature); p. 32 l. 18 διὰ τεσσάρων → διατεσσάρων (no accent, set solid). The transcriber’s uncertain points were resolved and confirmed: τοῖόνδε (both accents printed), ὁλοσχερῆ (σχ-ligature), λαμβάνον/παραλαμβάνει (ν with displaced acute, not αι), ἢ in p. 31 l. 23 (smooth breathing + grave as separate marks; rough breathing + acute is a joined sort in this fount), ἡ in p. 32 l. 22 (rough breathing only), μαλλον without circumflex, γοέτερον (ερ-ligature after τ), ποίκιλα, ἀπήρτισται (acute on η), the ἐστὶ compendium. running_text regenerated from the corrected lines; the note listing the ος-compendium corrected (p. 32 l. 13 γένος and p. 33 l. 11 μέλος have ος in letters).
